mapper.select: SELECT TUB.USER_ID, TUB.EMAIL, TUB.PASSWORD, TUB.NAME, TURM.ROLE, TUB.STATUS FROM TB_USER_MANAGE TUB INNER JOIN TB_USER_ROLE_MANAGE TURM ON TUB.USER_ID = TURM.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND TUB.EMAIL = #{EMAIL} AND TUB.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND TUB.STATUS IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_MANAGE WHERE EMAIL = #{EMAIL})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_MANAGE (EMAIL, PASSWORD, NAME, PHONE) VALUES (#{REQUEST_DTO.email}, #{ENCODED_PASSWORD}, #{REQUEST_DTO.name}, #{REQUEST_DTO.phone})
INSERT INTO TB_USER_ROLE_MANAGE (USER_ID, ROLE_CODE, CREATED_BY) VALUES (#{USER_ID}, 'USER', NULL)
